name: pspf-core
description: Local PSPF system of record, workspace bootstrap, validation, snapshots, and export operations.

pspf.core.initialiseOnActivation.description: Initialise the PSPF workspace automatically when PSPF Core activates. Intended for trusted debug or dedicated PSPF workspaces.

pspf.core.git.useSystemConfig.description: Use local Git config values as the default identity for PSPF Git-aligned workflows.

pspf.core.git.userName.description: Git user name override for PSPF workflows. Leave blank to fall back to local Git config when enabled.

pspf.core.git.userEmail.description: Git user email override for PSPF workflows. Leave blank to fall back to local Git config when enabled.

pspf.core.git.defaultBranch.description: Default Git branch label used by PSPF prompts and Git-aligned workflow messaging.

commands.title: PSPF: Reset Workspace To Clean Baseline

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm exec esbuild src/extension.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --external:vscode --banner:js='import { createRequire as __pspfCreateRequire } from "node:module"; import { fileURLToPath as __pspfFileURLToPath } from "node:url"; import { dirname as __pspfDirname } from "node:path"; const require = __pspfCreateRequire(import.meta.url); const __filename = __pspfFileURLToPath(import.meta.url); const __dirname = __pspfDirname(__filename);' --outfile=dist/extension.js && cp ../../node_modules/sql.js/dist/sql-wasm.wasm dist/sql-wasm.wasm && rm -rf dist/explorer-bundle && cp -R ../../schemas/explorer-bundle dist/explorer-bundle
